If polynomialVariety T is empty and Lambda is normalized (Lambda 1 = 1) with flat rank hypothesis and finite relation compatibility, then the moment matrix is not positive semidefinite (stated as moment_nonpositive_of_empty_variety; its exact conclusion is truncated in the source and not verified).

lemmas.statement: If the fixed-triple variety is empty, every normalized real moment functional with equal degree-two and degree-one ranks and finite relation compatibility has a degree-two moment matrix that is not positive semidefinite.
